scope: POSTHOC descriptive M0 medium-difficulty diagnostic on eight already-used multiscale 2D Helmholtz pilot systems: compare direct heterogeneous query fields to direct HOMOGENEOUS background fields with the SAME known source/loss/BC/PDE. This baseline has NO lowband response adaptation, so it is not a strong same-information competitor. Purpose only to check that multiscale heterogeneity has a substantial complex-wave effect despite near-exact full-field classical inverse. Hidden medium coefficients are removed before homogeneous forward solves.
